comment: The canyon steppe's and the stone desert's ground (doc/BIOME_PLAN.md 3.3), painted into <world>_biomes.png by tools/terrain_lab/steppe_ground.py on the biome map's grid. `rel` is where a cell stands between the lowest (0) and the highest (1) ground within `rel_window_m`; `slope` rise over run of the ground smoothed over a cell; `wet` how far the cell lies in a hollow of the ground round it (0 on crests, 1 in the deepest hollows within `wet_window_m`). Each layer, in order, paints its `biome` over the biomes `in` where the ground fits (`slope_min/max`, `rel_min/max`, `wet_max`) and its noise (cells of `noise_m`) weighs over its threshold (`cover` 1: all of it). `relief`: tools/terrain_lab/steppe_relief.py, the mesas cut into the heights before this.

layers.name: stone_walls
layers.comment: the steppe's tops are only its flat high ground: walls and slopes are stone desert

layers.name: mesa_top
layers.comment: every flat tier above the floor wears the steppe's yellow grass

layers.name: mesa_pocket
layers.comment: green pockets with the damp on the mesas' tops: 10-30% of each top (a connected flat high stretch), drawn by noise weighted towards its hollows

layers.name: canyon_floor
layers.comment: cracked dry crust on the canyons' floors and the approaches: flat low ground, not the wettest hollows (the beds)

relief.comment: floor: the region's low ground within window_m (+ washes wash_m, negative = cut); tops: the land smoothed over top_smooth_m, at least min_drop_m over the floor, cut into flat tiers tier_m high, each riser over `riser` of a tier, levels drifting by `drift` of a tier over drift_km, treads rolling roll_m; canyons: the ground below low_rel of the span, and ridges of a warped noise (trunk_km, branch_km weighted `branch`) over `cover` of the rest, sheer walls over wall_m, scree scree_m high reaching scree_reach_m out
